content_sections.heading: ICAR CIRCOT Young Professional-II Vacancy Details 2026
Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Graduate degree holders in Technology/ Textile Technology/ Textile Chemistry/ Chemical Engineering/ Biotechnology or Master’s Degree in Chemistry/ Environment Science/ Microbiology. Desirable: Experience in laboratory work like testing operation of equipment for cotton bleaching, cellulose extraction, biomass analysis, medical textile testing etc. Exposure to analytical test methods for various fibrous biomass materials and handling of analytical instruments. Working knowledge of computers/Internet.

content_sections.text: Minimum Age: 21 years Maximum Age: 45 years Age relaxation: 3 years for OBC, 5 years for SC/ST and 10 years for PH candidates as per GOI rules. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ICAR CIRCOT Young Professional-II Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 04-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Young Professional-II post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the Young Professional-II post is 04 September 2026. It is advisable to send your application well in advance of this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional-II position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Young Professional-II position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 42,000 per month. This is a fixed remuneration for the contractual period of employment.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum and maximum age limits for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for the Young Professional-II post is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 45 years. Candidates should ensure they fall within this age bracket to be eligible.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided as per Government of India rules. This includes 3 years for OBC candidates, 5 years for SC/ST candidates, and 10 years for PH candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Young Professional-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Young Professional-II post will be based on a Walk-in Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted and called for an interview based on their eligibility and application.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are required for the Young Professional-II post?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a Graduate degree in Technology/ Textile Technology/ Textile Chemistry/ Chemical Engineering/ Biotechnology or a Master’s Degree in Chemistry/ Environment Science/ Microbiology. Experience in laboratory work is also desirable.

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates apply for this position?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply via email. They should prepare their application with complete bio-data and attach self-attested copies of required documents, then send it to the official email address before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at ICAR Central Institute for Research on Cotton Technology, Mumbai, Maharashtra. The exact address and further details will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The job is on a contractual basis. The selected candidate will be appointed for a specific period as a Young Professional-II at ICAR CIRCOT.
